label: Trap Rap
style_parts: punchy trap rap over controlled 808 low end and rolling hi-hats, controlled 808 bass, punchy kick, dry snare or clap, crisp rolling hi-hats, sparse dark synth, bell or piano motif, 65-85 bpm, 4/4 half-time (one explicit counted feel; 130-170 double-time only if documented), dry close upfront vocal.
{gender} lead is rhythmic, confident and intelligible; short emphatic phrases and purposeful rests, not automatic triplet density.
The lead SPEAKS the lines tagged Spoken in a plain natural voice over the music, RAPS the lines tagged Rap with confident metered flow, and SINGS the lines tagged Sung with long held notes.
The intro and the outro are spoken; the full band keeps playing continuously under them.
ending_clause_added_by_ending_qc: , natural resolved ending, final chord rings out and fades
negative_tags: choir, reverb, echo, band dropout, acapella sections, talk-singing, monotone delivery
skeleton_rule: Intro (spoken opener) -> Vocalise (optional, a short wordless lead-in, never a forced opening) -> Verse -> Pre-Chorus -> Hook (the payoff: at or after the build-up, at the story beat where its words become true) -> verses and pre-choruses between hooks -> Product passage on beat 8 -> remaining hooks evenly -> last hook near 90% -> Outro (spoken CTA) -> [End].
villain_pain_lyric_guidance: VILLAIN IN THE LYRICS (Suno): name the villain in the verses, carry a pain line with real stakes and consequences, then turn to the rise in the hook. First person, present tense, concrete nouns -- the listener must feel the pain and the problem in the depth of their soul before the rise lands.
